create.name: Russ Hudson
create.bio:
Russ Hudson is one of the best-known teachers of the Enneagram, the nine-pointed map of personality, and has written and taught on it full-time since 1991. A graduate in East Asian studies from Columbia University, he worked for many years alongside the late Don Richard Riso. Together they wrote five books, among them Personality Types and The Wisdom of the Enneagram, now read in more than a dozen languages, and built the Riso-Hudson Enneagram Type Indicator, a questionnaire still in wide use. He co-founded the Enneagram Institute, helped set up the International Enneagram Association as a founding director, and later co-wrote Keys to the Enneagram with A. H. Almaas and Sandra Maitri.

His approach treats a person's type less as a label than as the starting point for inner work. Workshops pair psychological insight into each of the nine patterns with meditation, presence practice, movement, music and small-group exercises, aiming at a direct taste of qualities such as clarity, compassion and joy. He also has a scholar's interest in East Asian religion and the early history of Western spiritual thought. A New Yorker since 1980, he teaches around the world in person and online, sells recorded courses through his own site, and returns to Esalen in Big Sur for week-long Enneagram retreats.

books.title: The Wisdom of the Enneagram: The Complete Guide to Psychological and Spiritual Growth for the Nine Personality Types
books.author: Don Richard Riso and Russ Hudson
books.description: The best known of the Riso-Hudson books, first published by Bantam in 1999. It sets out the nine types with their levels of development and pairs each with practices for moving from habit towards presence.

books.title: Personality Types: Using the Enneagram for Self-Discovery
books.author: Don Richard Riso and Russ Hudson
books.description: A detailed reference to the nine types, revised with Russ Hudson in 1996. It describes each type across nine levels, from its most open expression to its most constricted.

books.title: Understanding the Enneagram: The Practical Guide to Personality Types
books.author: Don Richard Riso and Russ Hudson
books.description: A practical companion to their larger works, covering how to find your type, the wings and the lines of movement between types, with exercises for everyday use.

books.title: Keys to the Enneagram: How to Unlock the Highest Potential of Every Personality Type
books.author: A. H. Almaas, Sandra Maitri and Russ Hudson
books.description: A short book from Shambhala (2021) in which three senior teachers look at the Enneagram as a tool for spiritual realisation rather than typing alone, linking each type to an essential quality.

courses.title: The Transformational Enneagram: Mindfulness, Insight and Experience
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen in Big Sur on how the nine types arise from the thinking, feeling and instinctive centres and how each can open onto deeper qualities of essence. Teaching is woven together with group meditation, small-group work, movement and music.

courses.title: What We Have Learned and How We Apply It
courses.description: Recordings of a fourteen-hour, three-day workshop he taught with fellow Enneagram teacher Tom Condon. The two share the practices and perspectives they have found most useful over decades, blending psychological and spiritual approaches.

courses.title: The Inner Lines and The Missing Piece
courses.description: A five-part video series recorded with the Minnesota branch of the International Enneagram Association. It follows each type's path of growth along the inner lines of the symbol and adds an advanced teaching on the qualities that finally loosen ego.

courses.title: Roots of the Enneagram: On Whose Shoulders Are We Standing?
courses.description: A recorded ninety-minute class on where the Enneagram came from, drawing on his first-hand links with many of the system's key figures. It traces the older wisdom streams that the modern system brings together.

free_resources.title: Harmonics Video Series
free_resources.description: A free set of short videos on the three Harmonic groups of the Enneagram, which describe how each type tends to meet conflict and disappointment, with practical tips for each group.
